senses.gloss: na ca (as in Skt., see pw s.v. 3 vara, 2, e; Speyer, Skt. Synt. 〔§ 250〕; but here used in a rather peculiar way which has misled Burnouf, Kern, and Lüders ap. Hoernle MR 〔154〕), than, after comp.: (śīghrataraṃ) samyaksaṃbodhim abhisaṃbudhyeyaṃ na cāsya maṇeḥ pratigrāhakaḥ syāt SP 〔265.3〕 (prose), may I attain perfect enlightenment more quickly than there could be a receiver of (i.e. than one could accept) this jewel.
